description: Resolve any combination of company name, domain, or LinkedIn URL into one canonical company identity: the name, primary domain, and LinkedIn company URL, each with a 0-100 confidence score plus an overall score and a match method. Cross-checks the inputs you give it, resolves the ones you do not, and flags conflicts (a domain and a LinkedIn slug that disagree) instead of merging them. Login-free and public-data only. Takes one company or a list (company_names or domains), one row per company. Returns flat Clay-ready JSON. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and consumes Apify credits per call.

batchSize.description: How many companies from the lists are resolved at once. 1 to 10. Default: 2.

company_name.description: Company name, e.g. Stripe. Provide at least one of company_name, domain, or linkedin_url.

company_names.description: A list of company names to resolve in one run, one row per company. Use instead of company_name for a batch.

domain.description: Bare company domain, e.g. stripe.com. The strongest canonical key when provided.

domains.description: A list of bare company domains to resolve in one run, one row per domain. Use instead of domain for a batch.

linkedin_url.description: LinkedIn company URL (https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe) or bare slug (stripe).

skipCache.description: Force a fresh resolution and ignore the 7 day result cache.

name: resolve_company_identity
title: Resolve Company Identity
